summary: First-finish latency-sensitive testing for Fase 1 multi-tenant SaaS. Tested core auth, onboarding, tenant isolation (CRITICAL), brute-force lockout, memberships and full E2E UI flow (register→onboarding→dashboard→logout→bad login→valid login). All critical checks passed. Deep coverage (uploads, PATCH/DELETE memberships edge cases, role-gate for MANAGER/PROFESSIONAL, /settings pages, password reset) deferred to full testing pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/register: 200, sets httpOnly cookies, returns needs_onboarding=true, active_company=null
GET /api/auth/me: 401 without cookie, 200 with cookie returning user+active context
POST /api/auth/login: bad creds → 401 'Credenciais inválidas'; valid creds → 200 with active_company + active_role after onboarding
POST /api/auth/logout: 200 and returns Set-Cookie access_token=''/refresh_token='' Max-Age=0 (browser will clear)
Brute-force lockout: after 5 failed logins, correct password returns HTTP 429 'Muitas tentativas...'
POST /api/companies: creates tenant, returns id+slug (empresa-a-teste), auto-assigns OWNER (verified via GET /memberships)
GET /api/companies/me: 403 'Nenhuma empresa associada ao usuário' when user has no membership

TENANT ISOLATION (CRITICAL): user B sending X-Company-Id of tenant A on GET /companies/me → HTTP 403; PATCH /companies/me with forged header → HTTP 403; GET /memberships with forged header → HTTP 403. Tenant A data unchanged.
POST /api/memberships: OWNER invited a non-existing user by email → 201, membership+user created, role=PROFESSIONAL
GET /api/memberships: returns OWNER + newly-invited member for active tenant
Frontend /register: form loads, submit creates account and auto-redirects to /onboarding
Frontend /onboarding: name+business-type select (BARBERSHOP) submits and redirects to /dashboard
Frontend /dashboard: greeting 'Olá, UI 👋', company name shown, business_type badge 'Barbearia', 5 'Em breve' module cards (agenda visible)
Frontend header user menu → logout returns to /login
Frontend /login: inline error 'Credenciais inválidas' shown for bad password
Frontend valid login redirects an onboarded user directly to /dashboard
action_items: Full testing agent should still cover: unique slug -2 suffix generation, POST /uploads/company-image (logo/establishment happy path + wrong mime + oversize + cross-tenant download 403), PATCH /memberships/{id} cross-tenant rejection, DELETE self-membership rejection, PATCH /companies/me role gate (403 for PROFESSIONAL), /settings/company UI save + logo upload, /settings/users invite/change-role/remove UI, mobile hamburger drawer, /forgot-password + /reset-password (link is logged, not emailed in Fase 1).
